SELECT @@ FROM ( SELECT applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_city, position_id, position_code, position_title, position_step_title, dept_id, dept_name, position_type_ext_int, user_id, user_fname, user_lname, source_id,source_title, CASE WHEN number != feedback THEN action_type ELSE ? END AS action_type, CASE WHEN number != feedback THEN CASE WHEN action_type=? THEN ? WHEN action_type=? THEN ? WHEN action_type=? THEN ? WHEN action_type=? THEN ? END ELSE ? END AS action_required FROM ( SELECT *, count(*) AS number, CONVERT(sum(feedback_present), SIGNED) AS feedback FROM ( SELECT todo.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, ta.applicant_city, todo.position_id, tpos.position_code, tpos.position_title, todo.feedback_present, tpos.position_type_ext_int, tps.position_step_title, td.dept_id, td.dept_name, tu.user_id, tu.user_fname, tu.user_lname, todo.current_step_id, todo.todo_type,tps.position_step_isscheduled, todo.appointment_time,todo.appointment_status_id, ts.source_id,ts.source_title, CASE WHEN position_step_isscheduled =? THEN CASE WHEN todo.appointment_time is null THEN ? ELSE CASE WHEN todo.appointment_time < now() THEN CASE WHEN (todo.appointment_status_id !=? AND todo.appointment_status_id !=?) THEN ? ELSE ? END ELSE ? END END ELSE ? END AS action_type,
CASE WHEN todo.step_isscheduled=? THEN CASE WHEN todo.appointment_time IS NULL THEN IF(todo.user_responsible_for_scheduling=?,1,0) ELSE CASE WHEN todo.appointment_time < now() THEN CASE WHEN (todo.appointment_status_id !=? AND todo.appointment_status_id !=?) THEN CASE WHEN todo.interviewer_can_confirm=? THEN IF(todo.user_is_interviewer=? OR todo.user_responsible_for_scheduling=?,1,0) ELSE IF(todo.user_responsible_for_scheduling=?,1,0) END ELSE IF(todo.user_is_interviewer=? OR todo.user_is_decision_maker=?,1,0) END ELSE IF(todo.user_is_interviewer=?,1,0) END END ELSE 1 END AS todoUser
FROM tp_todo todo LEFT JOIN tp_users tu ON (todo.user_id=tu.user_id AND todo.feedback_present=?) ,tp_positions tpos LEFT JOIN tp_departments td ON (tpos.dept_id = td.dept_id) ,tp_applicants ta LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON (ta.source_id=ts.source_id), tp_position_steps tps WHERE todo.position_id=tpos.position_id AND todo.current_step_id = tps.position_step_id AND todo.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id AND todo.todo_type=? AND tpos.position_status = ? @@ )AS todo WHERE todoUser=1 @@ ) AS todo )AS filter WHERE 1 @@ @@

SELECT @@ FROM (SELECT ta.applicant_id, ta.applicant_name, tp.position_title, tp.position_code, tps.position_step_title AS step_title, tsl.step_level_name AS step_level_name, CONCAT(tu.user_fname,' ',tu.user_lname) AS rejected_by, tasp.process_moved_date AS rejected_date FROM tp_applicant_selection_process tasp, tp_applicants ta, tp_positions tp, tp_position_steps tps, tp_step_level tsl, tp_users tu WHERE tasp.position_step_id_to IN (0,-4,-6,-7) AND tasp.applicant_id = ta.applicant_id AND tasp.position_id = tp.position_id AND tasp.position_step_id_from=tps.position_step_id AND tps.position_step_level=tsl.step_level AND tasp.user_id = tu.user_id AND tp.position_id=? @@ ) a @@
